notes: F1 event times are stored as UTC/timezone-aware sessions and rendered for America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires with Intl.DateTimeFormat. Miami 2026 was corrected so it renders Sprint 13:00 ART, Qualifying 17:00 ART and Race 17:00 ART.
F2 session times were taken from the official F2 round pages and are track times unless otherwise noted.
For F2, both sprint_race and feature_race are included because the championship runs two race sessions per round.
Direct stable image URLs for driver headshots and team logos were not reliably exposed in the parsed official HTML, so those fields are null and official page URLs are included instead.
Formula 1 race results include full classified/NC rows for Australia, China and Japan as published before the Miami race weekend on 2026-05-02.
Formula 2 event times are event-local when known; the app converts known times to America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires using Intl. TBC remains visible as TBC.
asset_notes: Driver headshot URLs come from OpenF1's drivers endpoint and point to official media.formula1.com assets.
Most team logo URLs were replaced with direct public asset links from Wikimedia Commons.
Racing Bulls team_logo_url remains null because a stable direct logo asset was not verified in this pass.
